scope: Proposition 4.2 (Many-scale sector comparison) of the manuscript “The critical correlation exponent of the planar XY model” (preprints/The-critical-correlation-exponent-of-the-planar-XY-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e58587be77cd0256), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the preceding geometry there are numbers ηR → 0 such that, for each sufficiently large fixed R, one can choose a fixed m∗ for which log Zs Z0 − log Zs g Z0 g ≤ CM (1 + log n)ηR. (4.2) For these fixed choices, heights on the two inner rims, in the bounded cut coordinates just specified, are uniformly tight in n and in the outer volume. This is absolute tightness, without subtracting an additive constant.
